title: Our Revolution Landing Page Reveal
description: A preloader-to-hero landing reveal driven by a single GSAP timeline: a row of seven tall portrait images rises from below and staggers in, the whole strip slides horizontally, the side images and then the full black loader wipe away upward via clip-path, and finally the nav, hero headline and footer thumbnails slide up and fade in. Plays automatically once on page load using power3.inOut easing, about 6 seconds total.

images.desc: cinematic teal-toned scene of a lone figure walking across a wet reflective floor toward a shaft of light between dark angular walls
cinematic studio portrait of a seated man lit entirely in deep red, face and body sinking into shadow
astronaut standing on a foggy plain before a huge pale sphere, bathed in hazy golden sunset light
white Vanguardia studio wordmark centered on a solid black background
images.role: loader image strip center logo (#loader-logo, stays while others wipe away)

images.desc: moody dark shot glimpsed through a slit of a woman's lower face holding a lit cigarette, pale-blue painted nails
orange-lit silhouette of a person pressing a hand against frosted glass
dramatic side-lit portrait of a blonde woman in dark clothing against a dark teal backdrop
near-black cinematic profile of a face, only the nose and lips catching a thin amber rim of light
moody low-key portrait of a young man, half his face crossed by a hard shaft of cool light against darkness
portrait of a person in a black suit whose face is fully draped by a pale-blue tulle veil, gray studio background
hazy golden-hour city skyline of glass towers bathed in warm orange light

intent.useWhen: Úsalo como intro de una landing donde una tira de fotos verticales se revela y da paso al hero con titular, nav y galería de footer.

motion.title: Our Revolution Landing Page Reveal

capabilities.reason: velo de entrada a pantalla completa en la carga

motion.motion_signature: one-shot 4s power3.inOut intro: staggered y-rise of a 7-image strip + a 3s horizontal x:500->0 slide of the strip, then upward clip-path wipes (polygon bottom edge collapsed to the top) on the images and on the fixed black loader, ending with a staggered y/opacity rise of nav, headline and footer thumbs. No scroll, no rAF, no easing curve other than power3.inOut.
